Design, usability, creativity, content. A site of the day needs all four; the first two carry it.

What recent Sites of the Day share

  • One idea per site, carried all the way through
  • Type at extreme scale: giant statements next to tiny labels
  • Photography allowed to be the design, not decoration
  • One or two colours, chosen, not defaulted
  • A grid you can feel, even when it is broken on purpose

How each direction borrows

  • Masthead from Era Residence: letters framing a photograph
  • Index from Gil Huybrecht and Aspen: metadata header, numbered archive
  • Film from White Desert and Seasats: one photograph, one line
  • Document from Squarespace Foundations: the site as a calm brief
  • Statement from noho and illoca: one sentence, a strict grid, one colour
  • Field Notes from Trevor Noah and Decathlon Yestalgia: collage, stickers, hands
Every direction uses your own photographs and words drafted from your brief. The About section is a stand-in for the one we wrote together; anything in [brackets] is a placeholder. Pick one direction, or name the parts you want from two, and the build starts from there.
